component.name: NDManager
component.summary: Manage recording parameters and processing pipelines

description.p: NDManager helps neurophysiologists manage the parameters of their experimental recordings, such as the number of channels and the sampling rate of the acquisition system, and process their data: filtering, spike extraction, feature extraction and more, through scripts.
It is part of Neurosuite together with Klusters and NeuroScope. Please cite Hazan, Zugaro and Buzsáki (2006), J Neurosci Methods 155:207-216.
